messages:
Matt R: FYI AcmeCorp reporting spike of 502/504s during large embedding uploads around 10:12 UTC. Customer says it repros with chunked requests.
Priya S: saw the same in ingress logs — a cluster-wide bump in upstream resets from envoy: 
Matt R: timeline: model swap rollout started ~10:05 per deploybot, errors jump at 10:12. attaching quick curl they used.
Matt R: ```curl -v -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Billing-Id: acct_12345678901234567890' --data-binary @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings```
Jen L: can you paste a short trace id or sample upstream error line?
Priya S: sample from envoy error log: `upstream reset: recv failed (Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream` around trace=trace-0a3f
Jamal SRE: that billing header is huge — I'm suspicious of header buffer pressure on the midproxy or nginx. chunked bodies + large headers can push us over defaults.
Matt R: customer confirms header contains long tenant billing key, only happens for big batched embeds. small single-item requests fine.
infra-bot: DeployBot: rollout model-serving/v3 -> 25% started at 10:05 UTC, incrementing.
Priya S: whether it's model swap or buffer pressure, mitigation to try now: 1) pin tenant to model-serving/v2 (fallback) 2) temp increase nginx proxy_buffer_size and proxy_busy_buffers_size on midfront 3) raise Envoy upstream_idle_timeout to avoid mid-swap resets.
Matt R: creating support ticket ACME-5123 and asking tenant to test pinned endpoint. @AcmeCorp Rep can you try the pinned URL?
AcmeCorp Rep: trying now, sending same payload as before.
Matt R: small log snippet from midproxy around reset: `upstream write error: broken pipe while dispatching request id=abc123`
Jen L: also saw auth service returning 500 occasionally when headers length > 8k, maybe auth blob parsing timeout under high concurrency.
Jamal SRE: plan: roll back the v3 rollout, scale auth replicas x2, and raise connpool/docs timeouts. rolling rollback now.
infra-bot: DeployBot: rollback of model-serving/v3 completed at 10:30 UTC (success).
Priya S: monitoring — error rate dropped back to baseline within 3 minutes of rollback. rolling mitigation: changed proxy buffer sizes + auth replicas scaled.
AcmeCorp Rep: retesting — requests now successful. thanks.
Matt R: follow-ups: ticket ACME-5123 assigned to eng-runtime to add guardrails for header length + bulk embed path, and product to add guidance in docs for large-batch headers.
Priya S: putting a short runbook note: if 502/504 spike coincides with model rollout and large-chunked requests, suspect upstream resets from buffer/timeouts. quick fixes = pin model, rollback, increase proxy buffer + auth replicas.
Jen L: added trace ids to ticket (trace-0a3f, trace-0b4d).
Matt R: closing thread for now, reopening if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
